items.item: The voter is reached through the framework: `#[IsGranted]` on the action or `denyAccessUnlessGranted()`, not by calling the voter directly.

items.evidence: src/Controller/PostController.php:17 uses PostVoter::EDIT; declared at src/Security/Voter/PostVoter.php:11 public const EDIT = 'POST_EDIT';
